ads.headline: Dear Gums, I'm sorry.
ads.brief: A candid, slightly imperfect phone photo taken in a small home bathroom at night - warm vanity light over the mirror, everything else dim. On the basin shelf, a folded white greeting card stands propped against the mirror, hand-lettered in casual black marker, split exactly as: "Dear Gums," then "I'm sorry." - and below it, much smaller, on one line: "Let's start again." Spell every word exactly, nothing else written on the card. Lying flat on the basin edge near the tap: ONE old worn-out toothbrush, bristles visibly splayed and frayed outward - clearly retired after years of use. Standing upright front and centre on the basin, closest to camera: the LACALUT aktiv toothpaste tube, an EXACT match of the attached real packshot - real red/white German packaging, label facing the camera, true real-world size (card taller than the tube, tube longer than the toothbrush), lit by the warm vanity light with natural reflections on the porcelain and a soft contact shadow. Real lived-in bathroom details: slight water marks on the tap, a corner of a towel - authentic, NOT styled. It must look like a real photo someone snapped of their own sink, never a polished advertisement. No people, no hands, no gums or teeth anywhere, no other text or logos in the scene.
